notes: Fixed: Android male voice no longer falls back to a female-sounding default voice. Neutral voice names like "Google US English" are no longer mistaken for female voices.
Fixed: a system-default voice setting is now treated as male, so the male voice is always used unless you explicitly choose female.
Improved: the male voice picker and automatic selection now prefer genuinely male voices.
Faster: the app still boots in around 200ms and scrolls without the heavy glass blur.
Voice diagnostics now reports the exact voice your phone publishes.
